pr_title: Consolidate parameter alias resolution onto a single alias attribute
pr_description: Remove the separate `validation_alias`/`serialization_alias` properties on `ModelField` along with the `get_validation_alias` helper, using `field.alias` uniformly across request parsing (`dependencies/utils.py`), OpenAPI parameter naming (`openapi/utils.py`), and schema title generation (`_compat/v2.py`). Also removes the automatic `validation_alias`/`serialization_alias` defaulting from `alias` in the `Param` and `Body` constructors, since callers now resolve aliasing through the single `alias` attribute instead of juggling multiple alias fields.
